verses.pali: “Aṭṭhānametaṁ, bhikkhave, anavakāso yaṁ diṭṭhisampanno puggalo arahantaṁ jīvitā voropeyya. Netaṁ ṭhānaṁ vijjati.
verses.english: “It is impossible, mendicants, it cannot happen for an individual accomplished in view to murder a perfected one.

verses.pali: Ṭhānañca kho etaṁ, bhikkhave, vijjati yaṁ puthujjano arahantaṁ jīvitā voropeyya. Ṭhānametaṁ vijjatī”ti.
verses.english: But it is possible for an ordinary person to murder a perfected one.”
